sn24.8:1.1: _Mahā_ in the title refers to the length of the view, not to its quality.
sn24.8:1.3: The doctrine of the seven substances (_sattakāyavāda_) is attributed to Pakudha Kaccāyana at [dn2:26.2](); also at [mn76:16.2]().
sn24.8:1.15: The reading here (_nibbeṭhiyamānā sukhadukkhaṁ palenti_) differs from [dn2:20.11]() and [mn76:16.15](). _Sukhadukkhaṁ_ is the so-called “accusative of extension”, denoting the range to which the verb applies (Wijesekera, *Syntax of the Cases*, §44).
